title: Line diff engine on similar
problem_context:
- The diff viewer needs per-line diff information to render: old and new lines paired, each marked unchanged, removed, added, or modified, numbered from the line offset, with inline changes on modified lines.
- The component also needs to know where changes sit, so it can fold the unchanged lines around them.
- The reference is `src/compute-lines.ts`; alignment follows `similar`, so the TypeScript tests are a source of cases, not expected output.
plan_guidance:
- Every in-scope requirement binds acceptance alongside the criteria.
- Defaults generally follow react-diff-viewer, per stakeholder steering: character comparison and inline changes are on unless the consumer chooses otherwise.
- The engine carries no presentation; views, folding, and styling belong to the component and theming work units.
- Risk signal carried from the epic: implementation-complexity.
status_summary: Spun out of the port epic with activities and criteria consented. Next: collaborative pre-work review, Architect leading with Code Whisperer and Rust Tester; work-ready also needs a person's consent to the in-scope requirements, suggested candidate architecture, and a test strategy.

relevance: The crate the port lives in; the engine is its first code.
Reference line diff behavior being ported.
Reference cases to carry over where similar's alignment agrees.

title: Establish the crate
description: Establish the `rust-dioxus/` crate the port lives in.

title: Paired line information
description: Compute paired line information from two texts, per the in-scope line change and line number requirements.

title: Inline changes
description: Compute inline changes for modified lines under each compare method.

title: Changed-line positions
description: Provide the changed-line positions the component needs for folding.

title: Requirement tests
description: Cover every in-scope requirement with tests, drawing cases from `test/compute-lines-test.ts` where `similar`'s alignment agrees.

text: The component work unit can build split and inline views, and folding, from the engine's output alone, without diffing again.
Each reference case in `test/compute-lines-test.ts` is either carried over or recorded as differing because of `similar`'s alignment.
The TypeScript package at the repo root is unchanged.

body:
**Commits**
- `9a0699b`: line change and line number requirements drafted DREAMED for this unit's scope.

**Decisions**
- The Rust Roundup UI group (Dioxus Coder, Dioxus UI Patterns, Appshell Expert, Forms Expert) is left off this unit because the engine has no UI; the mission names it for the crate as a whole, and the component work unit takes it.

**Observations**
- `.project/architecture/` does not exist yet, so the first architecture record for this crate (the candidate architecture work-ready asks for) needs the Architect's placement choice first; low severity.

**For the next worker**
- `.project/` is a plain git worktree on branch `project` with no `.weaver/` tooling, so the Work Organizer's weave gates have nothing to run; commit inside the worktree with `git -C .project`.
- The toon MCP server is registered at user scope in `~/.claude.json`, not in a project `.mcp.json`; toon tools work in this repo regardless.
